summary: Gamehaus Holdings Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Nasdaq-listed (GMHS) holding company operating through PRC, Hong Kong and Singapore subsidiaries, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity program. The company may sell up to US$11,642,197 of Class A ordinary shares through ARC Group Securities LLC as sales agent under a Sales Agreement dated November 10, 2026, paying a 3.0% commission. Shares closed at US$0.6265 on November 9, 2026. The size equals one-third of the approximately US$34.9 million non-affiliate public float, the Form F-3 I.B.5 cap. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and any accelerated ATM usage.
